scope: Hook injection, two native d3 HXY measurements, r1=2 growth rounds, two native d5 HXY measurements; noiseless terminal code/logical projection; r2=0, no escape or decoder.
status: Explicit native reconstruction; updated source outside controlled blocks; not author-supplied actual-T circuit.
noise_convention: The paper native HXY schedule has 3,3,7,7 layers. Each native 2/3-qubit gate has depolarisation p; every unused data/cat site has idle depolarisation p per native layer. Outside replaced blocks all source noise is kept. Tdag-H readout uses source H noise with no extra Tdag channel. Explicit I is noiseless and its following source noise is preserved. Reported-bit faults M(p) use one noise location on a noiseless mathematical register, preserving the measured quantum state. Terminal readout is noiseless.
